mapper.select: SELECT IF(COUNT(USER_ID) > 0,'Y','N') AS EXISTS_YN FROM USER WHERE EMAIL = #{email}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member ( LOGIN_ID, PASSWORD, PARENT_PIN, NAME, EMAIL, PHONE, RELATION, AGREE_SERVICE, AGREE_PRIVACY, AGREE_SENSITIVE, AGREED_AT, NOTIFY_WEEKLY_REPORT, NOTIFY_REMINDER, AGREE_MARKETING, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{loginId}, #{password}, #{parentPin}, #{name}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{relation}, #{agreeService}, #{agreePrivacy}, #{agreeSensitive}, NOW(), #{notifyWeeklyReport}, #{notifyReminder}, #{agreeMarketing}, NOW() )
